build_policy.identities: Source/lock/driver/build/consumer/native/package hashes and procfs actual mapped native/executable paths accompany results. AOT linked managed code is identified by executable, not described as a dynamically loaded DLL.
build_policy.managed: Release Native AOT linux-x64; same actual CLI for each paired driver. Protocol/shared/direct-managed fixtures explicitly x86-64-v2. Reused B21/A17 consumers omit IlcInstructionSet; resolved compiler default is not asserted to equal v2.

measurement_python.rule: Invoke this exact interpreter for controllers and child adapters; unqualified Python under external native wrappers may select a different runtime and is not equivalent.

build_policy.native: Cargo --locked --release; repository thin LTO, one codegen unit, unwind; generic target, no host-native ISA
build_policy.packages: Fresh complete B24 previous closure per product version, including COMMON; A17 separate two-package codec closure. Same immutable driver and independent protocol client before/after.

concurrency.codec: 1 and 2 dedicated workers; mixed capacity/long group uses 2. Four workers are a separate oversubscription stress, not an unannounced long-group change.
concurrency.database: 1, 4, 8, 16 layering; mixed capacity/long group uses 16 client slots
concurrency.protocols: 1, 4, 16, 32, 64 layering; capacity/long group uses 64 slots, four HTTP/2 connections, 32 streams/connection

calibration.extension_rule: If all listed rates pass, extend by doubling until the first failed SLO/generator point or the finite one-million-observation bound. State any unbracketed capacity as a measured lower bound.
calibration.generator: All three domain drivers use maximum100ms dispatch lag, prospectively20% of the unchanged500ms arrival-p99 service limit. Every arrival latency includes full planned-to-completion delay. CPU, lag distribution, offered/dispatched/admitted counts remain separate. Excess lag invalidates the cell; generator/host-limited failures never establish a server-capacity upper bound.
calibration.long_rate_rule: The unchanged calibrators may emit their original 80%-of-capacity proposal. Recovery epoch 001 initially freezes the five explicit workload rates in freeze.json from the public reproduction bundle; a proposal does not replace them. If a required before qualification fails, stop and preserve it. Any prospective change requires a separate reviewed freeze before matched measurements; no after result retunes its paired before rate.
calibration.refinement_rule: Bisect highest passing / first failing rate bracket to width at most10% of passing rate, or adjacent integer rates when low<10. Confirm selected rate in three fresh60s processes; on failure step down10% and reconfirm, at most10 rounds.
calibration.warmup_and_recovery: Driver-declared warmup and same-live-process low-rate recovery excluded from effective load time. Retain overload and recovery observations.

freeze_completion: Before any product implementation edit, bind calibrated long rates, final driver/profile hashes, actual before artifacts and all lower-level fixture settings in a separate immutable frozen-execution.json. This prospective policy alone is not a claim that calibration or final freeze has completed.
long_acceptance: Ten distinct completed segments serially; fixed service/database CPUs2,3 and generator CPUs0,1. Actual first-to-last effective dispatch at least1800s each, valid generator and exact correctness/ownership/durability. Warmup/calibration/recovery/idle excluded. Interrupted or changed-binary stages do not count.

long_groups.name: sqlite

pre_product_revision_rationale.change_scope: Before first runtime edit, select a gRPC-only 64MiB retained-byte request cap for both product versions and direct Rust. The existing 4MiB cap cannot cover two overlapping configured-maximum frame grants. Global native64MiB/managed64MiB, RSS256MiB, message1MiB, payload/mix, TLS, error0, p99<=500ms and generator100ms are unchanged. HTTP remains on its original4MiB profile.
pre_product_revision_rationale.database_tooling: The separate A21 profile observed three generation2 pauses above100ms while all20522 operations completed. Measurement-tool retention changes require their own equivalence gates and fresh baseline measurements before freeze; they are never product gains.
pre_product_revision_rationale.direct_scope: Equal configured limits; NativeWeave reserves configured maximum per output frame while direct Rust charges actual frame bytes. Preserve and disclose this implementation cost difference.
pre_product_revision_rationale.evidence: grpc-baseline-quota-observation.md; actual before-grpc-v3r1/00-ladder-8 had two ordinary server-stream ResourceExhausted outcomes, not intentional probes.
pre_product_revision_rationale.old_verdicts: All old failures retain their original verdict and hashes. New gRPC calibration starts from the low point under the revised profile. This configuration revision is not a product optimization or measured improvement.

recovery_origin.legacy_policy_revision_field: 4 is retained for the unchanged public calibrator schema; recovery_policy_revision identifies this separate configuration.
recovery_origin.reason: Original measured workspace and artifact closure were not recovered; boot identity differs. This is a new paired cohort, not a continuation admission for historical binaries.

resource_policy.ancillary_cpu_policy: Source-only analysis may use CPU8 during calibration. During each long segment, no other local task commands except necessary read-only status observations; no builds/profiles/other loads. Remote CI may continue.
resource_policy.database_and_generator_resources: Observe separately; application RSS limit does not silently include the PostgreSQL service or generator.
resource_policy.expected_protocol_outcomes: Declared HTTP/gRPC cancellation and deadline probes must match their exact wire outcome and retire resources; report separately from successful ordinary calls.
resource_policy.failure: Correctness, durable-oracle, loaded-identity, generator-lag/capacity, cleanup or interference failures invalidate the sample. Preserve failures; never reinterpret them as zero errors or change a threshold retroactively.
resource_policy.generator_lag_definition: Existing controller dispatch-start timestamp, before event logging and stdin write/drain; not an exact wire-send timestamp. Record full lag distributions and all >50ms excursions separately.
resource_policy.layout_selection_evidence: codec-split-384-001: baseline package,60.050331522 actual dispatch seconds,23061/23061,valid generator,all observed masks checked,p99 arrival107682662ns; earlier shared-CPU diagnostic failures are excluded from final cohort and never called product gains.
resource_policy.schedule: Only one measured/profiled process tree at a time; all other task builds and loads stop. Read-only analysis and remote CI may continue.
resource_policy.scope: Application and local database use fixed virtual CPUs2,3; external arrival controllers/clients use disjoint CPUs0,1. All observed thread masks and process identities are checked. Four total CPU IDs are identical before/after/direct. Physical-host scheduling and hardware power controls are unavailable.

short_comparison.capacity: Report largest consistently passing sampled rate with bracket and generator caveat; same SLO/resources on both versions and direct Rust.
short_comparison.interleaving: Before, after, direct Rust; reverse order next repetition. Supplementary managed route where semantics permit. Same fixed arrival inputs/constraints at each point.
short_comparison.noise: Unchanged A21 noise_comparison: 2000 seeded independent bootstrap mean differences, 95% interval. Absolute noise band is the maximum process-mean range of baseline calibration repeats, at least 1000ns; relative band 0. Freeze band per scene from before data, do not choose it from optimization results.
short_comparison.tails: A21 nearest-rank rules; p99 unavailable with fewer than100 successful observations. Single long stages do not supply independent-process confidence intervals.
